name: production_nbest_confidence_gemma
description: Confidence pass over the full 5,012-term active imaging pool: gemma4-26b-qat samples 5 candidates per concept at temp 0.7 under style guide v6.0, purely to derive n_distinct as a review-priority signal (AUC 0.755 same-model for predicting incorrectness; 0.609 cross-model). Uses the EVAL-SAFE pool deliberately — with SME gold in retrieval the 177 already-reviewed concepts would look artificially unanimous. Selection is NOT used: picking among samples gains nothing (conclusion 54), but the sampling yields the best confidence estimate available.
